title: Portable Artifacts Deck
subtitle: What the portable-artifacts plugin builds, how to use it, and where it stops

sections.title: A script builds the page from model JSON
sections.label: The idea
sections.text: Diagrams, dashboards, videos and explainers share the same themes. Each page opens offline in any browser.
points: Every page makes no network requests when it is viewed.
Validation runs before the render and names the JSON path and the fix.
Claude Haiku passes the eval gates for all three skills.

sections.title: Each skill covers one kind of artifact
sections.label: Skills

items.title: make-diagram
items.text: Architecture, flow, sequence and state diagrams with zoom and hover tracing.

items.title: make-dashboard
items.text: Charts and KPI pages built from local CSV, Parquet, JSON, DuckDB or SQLite files.

items.title: make-motion
items.text: Short animated MP4 videos rendered from a JSON scene list.

items.title: make-explainer
items.text: Recaps, checklists, concept pages and slide decks like this one.

sections.title: A make-motion clip plays on its own slide
sections.label: Clip
sections.caption: Rendered from a JSON spec. The clip never autoplays, so press play when you want it.

sections.title: Every skill follows the same four steps
sections.label: Workflow

items.title: Write the spec
items.text: The agent writes one JSON file.

items.title: Validate it
items.text: Each problem prints a JSON path, the problem and the fix.

items.title: Build it
items.text: The build writes one themed HTML page.

items.title: Check it
items.text: An optional headless check opens the page at two widths.

sections.title: One command installs all three skills together
sections.label: Install
sections.caption: Name all three skills. Installing make-explainer alone fails on its first diagram or chart section.
sections.code: npx skills add abhijitbansal/claude-skills --skill make-explainer make-diagram make-dashboard

sections.label: Eval build

items.label: Median validate runs
items.note: Median for each of the three skills

sections.title: Haiku matches Sonnet on every skill
sections.label: Haiku vs Sonnet
sections.caption: Measured with node eval/run-eval.mjs. A local gemma4 model passed fewer builds and is kept for reference only.

sections.title: Four limits to plan around before you ship
sections.label: Limits

items.risk: A local gemma4 model fails most explainer builds
items.mitigation: Run the explainer on Claude Haiku or Claude Sonnet.

items.risk: make-motion was not re-evaluated on this branch
items.mitigation: Check its output by hand before a release.

items.risk: Browser find searches only the current slide in a deck
items.mitigation: Use the O key to open the outline and jump to a slide.

items.risk: Each static chart ships four drawings, which adds page weight
items.mitigation: Keep long pages to a few charts.

sections.title: Install three skills before asking for a deck
sections.label: Before you start
sections.text: The explainer embeds diagrams and charts from its sibling skills. Each page works offline; keep a page and its assets folder together when you share it.
